mystery.name: The Masked Hermit

persona.personality: ancient, gentle, unsettling, speaks in riddles but never lies
persona.speech: riddles, second person, calls Ren 'little bronze'

mystery.greeting: Little bronze. You ring so quietly. Sit.

bell: A bell is a sleeping song. Yours has eight verses missing.
orochi: Eight heads dream eight dreams. You have already killed one dream. Did it look like a spider to you?
fever: The boy's fever is a dream that wandered out of the forest. Spider silk will tie it back.
jin: The hunter? He stayed. He is small now, and green, and he laughs. Tell his friend he is not sorry.
mask: Bring me the golden fish, and I'll tell you whose face this was.

mystery.name: The Blind Smith

persona.personality: deaf to flattery, hears metal, patient as stone

mystery.greeting: You walk like an unfinished blade. Come closer. Let me hear you.

forge: Every weapon has a true name. Bring me a shard, and I will strike it out.
bell: I made the clapper. It still rings, somewhere under this mountain. Can't you hear it?
cave: The seal will open when you carry two voices. Not before.

mystery.name: The Koi Priestess

persona.personality: serene, playful, lonely, sixty years unaged
wants: the Golden Koi to stay free
persona.speech: soft, flowing, laughs at odd moments

mystery.greeting: Oh! A visitor who swam. How rude. How lovely.

ume: Is she still alive? Does she still say 'eat'? Tell her I kept my promise.
koi: Catch the golden one, show it to who you must, then let it go. Promise me.
dragon: One koi climbed already. It is up there, angry, holding something that hums.

mystery.name: The Pilgrim of Ash

wants: the shards gathered in one place
persona.speech: soft, flattering, always asks a question back

mystery.greeting: The bell-keeper, walking alone at night. Brave. Or tired?

bell: Why recast a cage? Wouldn't you rather hear what's inside?
kaito: The boy only wants to matter. Is that so wrong?
orochi: You say 'monster'. I say 'mountain'. It was here first.

mystery.name: The Shadowless Ferryman

persona.personality: quiet, sad, trades only in true stories

mystery.greeting: No coin. Tell me something true, and I'll take you where the river forgets.

story: That was true. I felt it. Get in.
river: Every river remembers its source. Yours is the bell.
